📂 Load from a folder (make folders on any computer)
Make a folder, put your audio and .glb models in it (sub-folders are fine), then press Load a folder. The game sorts everything by folder and file name – e.g. a folder called minos with intro, outro, voice, theme inside. Got a pack .zip? Unzip it and load that folder, or drop the .zip below. Folder template gives you the empty folders.
…or drop a folder, files or a pack .zip here
The pack has all your files plus your settings and key binds. Take it to another computer, open the game, and use Load a pack.
